fields.name: job_name
fields.label: Job name
fields.help: The input's name; a sanitised version of it names the output directory and files.

fields.name: sequence_molecules
fields.label: Molecules
fields.help: Add one box per unique entity. Chain IDs are uppercase letters (A, or A, B for two copies); left blank, unused IDs are assigned. A ligand is a SMILES string, or one or more CCD codes (CCD_ATP; CCD_NAG, CCD_NAG, CCD_BMA for a multi-component ligand such as a glycan, joined with Bonded atom pairs). SMILES ligands cannot take part in bonds. An ion is its CCD code (MG, ZN, CA). Modifications take a CCD code at a 1-based position. MSA paths are optional precomputed A3M files on the runner; a protein given only one of the two runs with the other empty. Cyclic chains are not supported: AlphaFold 3 does not accept bonds within or between polymer chains.

fields.name: model_seeds
fields.label: Model seeds
fields.help: Comma-separated integer random seeds (modelSeeds); at least one is required. The model runs once per seed, and each run produces Diffusion samples structures.

fields.name: bonded_atom_pairs
fields.label: Bonded atom pairs (JSON, optional)
fields.help: Native bondedAtomPairs: covalent bonds as pairs of [entity ID, 1-based residue index, atom name], e.g. [[["A", 12, "SG"], ["B", 1, "C25"]]] for a covalent ligand, or the bonds between the components of a multi-CCD ligand. Atom names come from the CCD; bonds within or between polymer chains are not supported.

fields.name: user_ccd
fields.label: User-provided CCD (mmCIF, optional)
fields.help: Native userCCD: chemical components in CCD mmCIF format, defining custom ligands or modified residues (referenced by component ID from a ligand's CCD codes or a modification), with named atoms for bonds and ideal coordinates for when RDKit cannot generate a conformer. Avoid underscores in custom component IDs.

fields.name: input_json
fields.label: AlphaFold 3 input (JSON)
fields.help: A complete AlphaFold 3 input: one object in the alphafold3 dialect (name, modelSeeds, sequences of protein, rna, dna and ligand entities, optional bondedAtomPairs and userCCD, dialect "alphafold3", version 1-4), or an AlphaFold Server job list, which AlphaFold 3 converts.
fields.help_note: Bio Web writes this text to a file on the runner, so any unpairedMsaPath, pairedMsaPath, mmcifPath, or userCCDPath inside it must be an absolute path available there. Entities that already carry MSAs or templates keep them.

fields.name: inputs_file
fields.label: Input file (JSON)
fields.help: An AlphaFold 3 input JSON file, in the alphafold3 dialect or as an AlphaFold Server job list.
fields.help_note: Choose a file. Its contents are read here and sent as the input document.

fields.name: msa_source
fields.label: MSAs and templates
fields.help: Where MSAs and templates come from for entities whose input does not already give them. ColabFold: each distinct protein sequence is sent to the MSA server below; in a complex of several distinct proteins the server's paired alignment is placed first in each chain's unpaired MSA, as the input docs recommend for custom pairing. RNA runs MSA-free and no templates are used. None: every chain runs from its sequence alone (private sequences, offline runs), at a large cost in accuracy. AlphaFold 3 data pipeline: Jackhmmer, Nhmmer and Hmmsearch over the ~630 GB genetic databases, which must be installed on the runner.

fields.name: msa_server_url
fields.label: MSA server
fields.help: The ColabFold MMseqs2 API the ColabFold option sends protein sequences to.

fields.name: max_template_date
fields.label: Maximum template date
fields.help: YYYY-MM-DD (--max_template_date). The data pipeline ignores templates released after it, and only CCD components released before it may fall back to their model coordinates when RDKit cannot generate a conformer. The default is the AlphaFold 3 paper's date.

fields.name: resolve_msa_overlaps
fields.label: Deduplicate unpaired against paired MSAs
fields.help: --resolve_msa_overlaps, the paper's behaviour. Turned off automatically when the ColabFold option builds paired alignments, since deduplication would break their row pairing.

fields.name: num_diffusion_samples
fields.label: Diffusion samples
fields.help: Structures sampled per seed (--num_diffusion_samples). The default is 5.

fields.name: num_recycles
fields.label: Recycles
fields.help: Trunk recycling iterations (--num_recycles). The default is 10.

fields.name: num_seeds
fields.label: Number of seeds (optional)
fields.help: --num_seeds: run this many seeds, counting up from the input's single seed, which must then be the only one it gives. Blank uses the input's seeds as they are.

fields.name: conformer_max_iterations
fields.label: RDKit conformer iterations (optional)
fields.help: --conformer_max_iterations: raise RDKit's conformer search limit when a ligand fails with "Failed to construct RDKit reference structure". Blank keeps RDKit's default.

fields.name: fix_standalone_glycans
fields.label: Keep leaving atoms of standalone glycans
fields.help: --fix_standalone_glycans. AlphaFold 3 was trained with leaving atoms removed even from glycans bonded to nothing; this keeps them, away from the regime it was trained in.

fields.name: run_inference
fields.label: Run inference
fields.help: Off: stop after the MSA and template step and return the completed input JSON (with the ColabFold or data-pipeline MSAs in it), for reuse in a later run.

fields.name: save_embeddings
fields.label: Save embeddings
fields.help: Write each seed's final single and pair embeddings (--save_embeddings); these are large float16 arrays.

fields.name: save_distogram
fields.label: Save distogram
fields.help: Write each seed's final distogram (--save_distogram), a num_tokens x num_tokens x 64 float16 array.

fields.name: compress_large_output_files
fields.label: Compress large output files
fields.help: Write the mmCIF and confidences JSON zstandard-compressed (--compress_large_output_files). Compressed structures are not shown in the viewer.

fields.name: flash_attention_implementation
fields.label: Attention implementation
fields.help: --flash_attention_implementation. Choose XLA for a compute capability 7.x GPU (V100, T4, RTX 20xx); the runner then also sets the XLA flag AlphaFold 3 requires for those devices.

options.label: XLA (portable; required for 7.x GPUs and CPU)

fields.name: jax_backend
fields.label: JAX backend
fields.help: --jax_backend. CPU inference needs the XLA attention implementation.

fields.name: gpu_device
fields.label: GPU device
fields.help: Zero-based JAX device index (--gpu_device), after any CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES filtering.

fields.name: unified_memory
fields.label: Unified memory
fields.help: Let GPU memory spill into host memory instead of failing out of memory, for GPUs with less than 80 GB: sets XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false, TF_FORCE_UNIFIED_MEMORY=true and XLA_CLIENT_MEM_FRACTION=3.2, as the performance docs recommend. Slower.

fields.name: buckets
fields.label: Compilation buckets (optional)
fields.help: --buckets: strictly increasing, comma-separated token counts that inputs are padded to, so a compiled model can be reused. Blank keeps AlphaFold 3's defaults (256 to 5120).
